name: mcp-ai-wpoos
description: NV Digital Open Operator System (NV oOS) is an Object-Oriented AI Framework/Harness for WordPress connecting your data with OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Hugging Face, Cloudflare, OpenRouter & Ollama (Local) models. Create & manage AI Assistants that can interact with users, access WordPress (API) data, & perform as a MCP Server & Chat Agent

paragraphs: 🆕 v1.2.4 Highlights: MCP client-quirk hardening, chart recipes, Model Foundry Phase 1, and the Content Graph SPA page. MCP hardening (PR #7007, Proposal 066) — every advertised tools/list schema now carries a root type: object, hazardous schemas are skipped-with-reason instead of dropping the whole catalog (the new WPMCPAIToolSchemaAuditor), nvoosgetprofile advertises structuredContent, and discovery caches respect server TTLs and invalidate on tools/listchanged; the CG-AI standalone mirror ports the same hardening. Chart recipes (PRs #7003, #7005) — fenced nvoos-chart JSON renders as real…

MCP Specification: 2026-07-28 (Stateless Core, Full Compliance) Maintained by NV Digital License: GPLv3 or later Requires: WordPress 6.0+, PHP 7.4+ Patent Status: Patent Pending (Application #19/410,504) Documentation: Grade A (95/100) — 1,617 files across 12 directories, 108 admin screenshots, 100% feature coverage

Real-time AI Orchestration Toolkit / Harness for Wordpress - NV oOS is a modular AI framework (Object-Oriented System) for WordPress that connects your site's data with 18 language-model providers: OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Baseten, Kimi (Moonshot), Z.AI (GLM), DigitalOcean, NVIDIA NIM, Cloudflare Worker AI, Azure, Ollama, LM Studio, Hugging Face, and TypeSafe Jev (decision-only), plus local WebLLM and embedded engines. It allows you to create and manage AI Assistants that can interact with users, access WordPress data, and perform custom tool functions.
features: Every HTTP request spawns a new process that dies after responding
No native event loop or async coordination

requirements.text: Fixed — the standalone SPA's cross-host login redirects and the vendored explorer's AJAX auth (#6999/#7000/#7002/#7004/#7006), the static-server nosniff + ramped HSTS headers (#7009), and the F&B toolkit toggle that never rendered (#7010).

Cookie-mode login re-scoped through the proxy (absolute wp-login.php form actions broke cross-host deploys); the knowledge-graph explorer's $.ajax calls now carry bearer/basic/guest/worker auth via an ajaxPrefilter; tsconfig paths + CI build-verify unblock the Velocity deploy; serve.mjs gains a shebang (Velocity executes the entry through sh) + explicit server.on('error')…
